race.comment: ELNAJEEB (2) returns after a 19-week spell for a second campaign. Showed ability when last in work, the high point a close third over this distance at Doomben. Two recent trials should have him forward enough to make a successful return. THE GRAND DUCHY (7) had every chance but struggled at the end of 1200m at Doomben recently. Deserves another chance in this easier maiden and coming back to 1100m. Market watch on Matthew Dunn's first starter FRENCH MELODY (5) who hasn't been all that far away in her last couple of trials. SCARLETT BLAZE (13) is another on debut that should be monitored closely. Took out a recent trial at Beaudesert and has been kept very safe in early markets. Confident the winner comes from this quartet.
